summary: [spec fidelity, P3] The When of subject.lifecycle.39 says the subject is 'with b's scenario attested, shipped again'. In subject_lifecycle_39_ship_names_the_tagged_draft_and_every_change_set_aside (crates/canon-cli/tests/brief_scope.rs:854-890), b's scenario shop.cart.03 is never attested before the refused ship, and the subject was never shipped: it ships from verifying. shipped_with_tagged_draft does not attest shop.cart.03 either. Fix: word the When as the test runs it ('and the verifying subject shipped'), or attest shop.cart.03 before the refused ship.
